Terms of use of your personal data:
The information collected by France Médias Monde is intended to be used to send you contents and information by e-mail. All in relation to the shows, events and news of the France Médias Monde channels linked to the subscription choices you have made, as well as to monitor the audiences for this service.
You can unsubscribe at any time via the unsubscribe link located in each newsletter. France Médias Monde will keep your data until you have unsubscribed or been automatically unsubscribed after thirteen (13) months of inactivity
The information collected is intended for France Médias Monde and the users purposes.
In accordance with the French Data Protection Act n°78-17 of 6 January 1978 as amended, as well as the European Regulation n°2016-679 on the protection of personal data, you have the right to access, rectify, delete, oppose and port your personal data, as well as the right to limit the processing.
To exercise your rights, please send a letter to the following address: France Médias Monde, Data Protection Officer, 80 rue Camille Desmoulins, 92130 Issy-les-Moulineaux, France or an email to: dpd@francemm.com, specifying the subject of your request.
You have the option of filing a complaint with a supervisory authority if you believe that your rights to your data are not respected after having contacted us.
